```sql
WITH rates AS (
    SELECT 
        district,
        year,
        100.0 * anc4_completed / pregnancies_registered AS rate
    FROM anc_visits
    WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda')
      AND year IN (2021, 2023)
)
SELECT 
    r2023.district,
    r2023.rate - r2021.rate AS percentage_point_change
FROM rates r2023
JOIN rates r2021 
    ON r2023.district = r2021.district
WHERE r2023.year = 2023
  AND r2021.year = 2021;
```
